name: vscode-settings-on-theme-switch
description: Apply different settings for light, dark, and high-contrast color themes, or for specific themes by name.

settingsOnThemeSwitch.darkColorThemeSett.markdownDescription: Settings to apply when a dark color theme is active, as a map of setting ID to value. Example: `{ "editor.fontWeight": "400" }`.

settingsOnThemeSwitch.lightColorThemeSet.markdownDescription: Settings to apply when a light color theme is active, as a map of setting ID to value. Example: `{ "editor.fontWeight": "500" }`.

settingsOnThemeSwitch.highContrastDarkCo.markdownDescription: Settings to apply when a high-contrast dark color theme is active. Layered on top of `#settingsOnThemeSwitch.darkColorThemeSettings#`, so list only what's different.

settingsOnThemeSwitch.highContrastLightC.markdownDescription: Settings to apply when a high-contrast light color theme is active. Layered on top of `#settingsOnThemeSwitch.lightColorThemeSettings#`, so list only what's different.

settingsOnThemeSwitch.themeSettings.markdownDescription: Settings to apply for specific color themes, keyed by theme name as it appears in `#workbench.colorTheme#`. Layered on top of the dark, light, and high-contrast settings. Example: `{ "Default Dark Modern": { "editor.fontWeight": "450" } }`.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
